t: A list of ways to die that he asked to be spared
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَدْمِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ التَّرَدِّي وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْغَرَقِ وَالْحَرَقِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ يَتَخَبَّطَنِي الشَّيْطَانُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ
p: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-hadm, wa aʿūdhu bika mina-t-taraddī, wa aʿūdhu bika mina-l-gharaqi wa-l-ḥaraqi wa-l-haram, wa aʿūdhu bika an yatakhabbaṭanī-sh-shayṭānu ʿinda-l-mawt
m: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being buried under rubble, and from falling, and from drowning and burning and decrepitude, and I seek refuge in You from Satan striking me down at the moment of death.
